title: CI: use go v1.26 for both `release.yml` and `ci.yml` (don't use `go.mod` version)
body:
Users have reported some issues with Podman built with the stable version of go (this is the version used in the release workflow):

https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/29891

The problem hasn't been reproduced in PR checks because because it uses a different version of Go (from `go.mod`).

This commit updates `ci.yaml` to be consistent with `release-build-artifacts.yml`.

comments.body:
> LGTM, I wonder however if we should just set `go-version: 1.27` everywhere, renovate is smart enough to update these and then we can a proper renovate PR to bump the version and we hopefully see once in CI if it works or not instead of getting broken randomly which is bad.

Yes I agree. I have updated the PR to use `1.26` to address #29891. We should set it to `1.27` when go version 1.27.2 is out.
